ruleDefinitions.name: File Download Via Bitsadmin To An Uncommon Target Folder
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of bitsadmin downloading a file to uncommon target folder

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\bitsadmin\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "bitsadmin\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/transfer\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/create\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/addfile\\ .*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%AppData\\%.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%temp\\%.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%tmp\\%.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*")))
